# Vue 3 components (.vue)

Pajamas-inspired component library generated by scripts/gen-vue.js from
scripts/component-spec.js + dist/css/variables.css.

CombPosition API via `<script setup>` + `<style scoped>`. Floating layers (`Modal`, `Toast`, `Dropdown`) use `<Teleport to="body">`.

## Import

    import { GlButton, GlInput, GlAlert } from './dist/vue3/components';

## Components

| File | Export | Props |
|---|---|---|
| Button.vue | GlButton | category, variant, size, disabled, loading, icon, block |
| Input.vue | GlInput | type, placeholder, state, disabled, readonly, width |
| Modal.vue | GlModal | visible, title, size, primaryAction, secondaryAction, onClose |
| Table.vue | GlTable | items, fields, loading, sortBy, sortDesc |
| Tabs.vue | GlTabs | tabs, active, onChange |
| Badge.vue | GlBadge | variant, icon, href |
| Toast.vue | GlToast | message, action, autoHideDelay, onDismiss |
| Dropdown.vue | GlDropdown | text, items, showClearAll, onSelect |
| Form.vue | GlForm | label, helper, error, optional |
| Alert.vue | GlAlert | variant, title, dismissible, sticky |

## Design tokens

Every color / size / radius / font references a CSS variable from
dist/css/variables.css (var(--gl-*)). Tokens from the spec that do not
exist in variables.css are mapped at generation time to the closest real
token; the mapping comment is inlined next to each usage:

- --gl-modal-small-width -> --gl-spacing-scale-31 (--gl-modal-small-width 未在 variables.css 定义，映射 --gl-spacing-scale-31)
- --gl-modal-medium-width -> --gl-spacing-scale-48 (--gl-modal-medium-width 未在 variables.css 定义，映射 --gl-spacing-scale-48)
- --gl-modal-large-width -> --gl-spacing-scale-62 (--gl-modal-large-width 未在 variables.css 定义，映射 --gl-spacing-scale-62)
- --gl-text-base-font-size -> --gl-font-size-base (--gl-text-base-font-size 未定义，映射 --gl-font-size-base)
- --gl-text-sm-font-size -> --gl-font-size-sm (--gl-text-sm-font-size 未定义，映射 --gl-font-size-sm)
- --gl-text-base-line-height -> --gl-line-height-20 (--gl-text-base-line-height 未定义，映射 --gl-line-height-20)
- --gl-text-strong-color -> --gl-text-color-strong (--gl-text-strong-color 未定义，映射 --gl-text-color-strong)
- --gl-text-subtle-color -> --gl-text-color-subtle (--gl-text-subtle-color 未定义，映射 --gl-text-color-subtle)
- --gl-zindex-modal -> --gl-zindex-4 (--gl-zindex-modal 未定义，映射 --gl-zindex-4)
- --gl-zindex-toast -> --gl-zindex-200 (--gl-zindex-toast 未定义，映射 --gl-zindex-200)
- --gl-zindex-dropdown -> --gl-zindex-3 (--gl-zindex-dropdown 未定义，映射 --gl-zindex-3)

Import the tokens once in your app entry:

    @import '../css/variables.css';
